pass_findings.finding: The recovery-v2 controller persisted MATCH, MATCH and MISS for issuer revenue, electric-pot revenue and issuer operating cash flow respectively.
The pre-outcome resolution contract maps the settled pattern to MIXED_PATTERN_H_A_NOT_ESTABLISHED.
The operating-cash-flow MISS is correctly described as an economically favorable upward deviation from the frozen STABLE band and remains mechanically labeled MISS.
Absolute electric-pot revenue growth is not promoted to competitive share, customer loyalty or management-action causality.
Issuer-revenue and operating-cash-flow reported comparative values that differ from the frozen baselines remain UNKNOWN perimeter or restatement bridge questions.
The accepted R11 episode and the E2 resolution contract predate outcome access and were not rewritten after the outcome was observed.
E3 remains NOT_ADMITTED and the settlement grants no method-transfer, CJO, valuation, report, BuyBand or investment authority.

non_blocking_caveat: The statement that product growth was slower than issuer growth is only a comparison of movements from their separately frozen baselines. Because the issuer comparative column differs from the frozen baseline, it cannot be upgraded to a perimeter-matched organic-growth, share or loyalty conclusion.

review_execution.authority_basis: Controller-persisted contracts, observations and settlements bound to official source receipts.
